verses.en: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
verses.pt: Então respondeu Elifaz, o temanita, e disse:
verses.en_web: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
verses.en_bbe: And Eliphaz the Temanite made answer and said,

verses.en: If we assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking?
verses.pt: Se alguém intentar falar-te, enfadarte-ás? Mas quem poderá conter as palavras?
verses.en_web: “If someone ventures to talk with you, will you be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?
verses.en_bbe: If one says a word, will it be a weariness to you? but who is able to keep from saying what is in his mind?

verses.en: Behold, thou hast instructed many, and thou hast strengthened the weak hands.
verses.pt: Eis que tens ensinado a muitos, e tens fortalecido as mãos fracas.
verses.en_web: Behold, you have instructed many, you have strengthened the weak hands.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, you have been a helper to others, and you have made feeble hands strong;

verses.en: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.
verses.pt: As tuas palavras têm sustentado aos que cambaleavam, e os joelhos desfalecentes tens fortalecido.
verses.en_web: Your words have supported him who was falling, You have made firm the feeble knees.
verses.en_bbe: He who was near to falling has been lifted up by your words, and you have given strength to bent knees.

verses.en: But now it is come upon thee, and thou faintest; it toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.
verses.pt: Mas agora que se trata de ti, te enfadas; e, tocando-te a ti, te desanimas.
verses.en_web: But now it has come to you, and you faint. It touches you, and you are troubled.
verses.en_bbe: But now it has come on you and it is a weariness to you; you are touched by it and your mind is troubled.

verses.en: Is not this thy fear, thy confidence, thy hope, and the uprightness of thy ways?
verses.pt: Porventura não está a tua confiança no teu temor de Deus, e a tua esperança na integridade dos teus caminhos?
verses.en_web: Isn’t your piety your confidence? Isn’t the integrity of your ways your hope?
verses.en_bbe: Is not your fear of God your support, and your upright way of life your hope?

verses.en: Remember, I pray thee, who ever perished, being innocent? or where were the righteous cut off?
verses.pt: Lembra-te agora disto: qual o inocente que jamais pereceu? E onde foram os retos destruídos?
verses.en_web: “Remember, now, whoever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?
verses.en_bbe: Have you ever seen destruction come to an upright man? or when were the god-fearing ever cut off?

verses.en: Even as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, and sow wickedness, reap the same.
verses.pt: Conforme tenho visto, os que lavram iniquidade e semeiam o mal segam o mesmo.
verses.en_web: According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity, and sow trouble, reap the same.
verses.en_bbe: What I have seen is that those by whom trouble has been ploughed, and evil planted, get the same for themselves.

verses.en: By the blast of God they perish, and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed.
verses.pt: Pelo sopro de Deus perecem, e pela rajada da sua ira são consumidos.
verses.en_web: By the breath of God they perish. By the blast of his anger are they consumed.
verses.en_bbe: By the breath of God destruction takes them, and by the wind of his wrath they are cut off.

verses.en: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
verses.pt: Cessa o rugido do leão, e a voz do leão feroz; os dentes dos leõezinhos se quebram.
verses.en_web: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
verses.en_bbe: Though the noise of the lion and the sounding of his voice, may be loud, the teeth of the young lions are broken.

verses.en: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, and the stout lion’s whelps are scattered abroad.
verses.pt: Perece o leão velho por falta de presa, e os filhotes da leoa andam dispersos.
verses.en_web: The old lion perishes for lack of prey. The cubs of the lioness are scattered abroad.
verses.en_bbe: The old lion comes to his end for need of food, and the young of the she-lion go wandering in all directions.

verses.en: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, and mine ear received a little thereof.
verses.pt: Ora, uma palavra se me disse em segredo, e os meus ouvidos perceberam um sussurro dela.
verses.en_web: “Now a thing was secretly brought to me. My ear received a whisper of it.
verses.en_bbe: A word was given to me secretly, and the low sound of it came to my ears.

verses.en: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falleth on men,
verses.pt: Entre pensamentos nascidos de visões noturnas, quando cai sobre os homens o sono profundo,
verses.en_web: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on men,
verses.en_bbe: In troubled thoughts from visions of the night, when deep sleep comes on men,

verses.en: Fear came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones to shake.
verses.pt: sobrevieram-me o espanto e o tremor, que fizeram estremecer todos os meus ossos.
verses.en_web: fear came on me, and trembling, which made all my bones shake.
verses.en_bbe: Fear came on me and shaking, and my bones were full of trouble;

verses.en: Then a spirit passed before my face; the hair of my flesh stood up:
verses.pt: Então um espírito passou por diante de mim; arrepiaram-se os cabelos do meu corpo.
verses.en_web: Then a spirit passed before my face. The hair of my flesh stood up.
verses.en_bbe: And a breath was moving over my face; the hair of my flesh became stiff:

verses.en: It stood still, but I could not discern the form thereof: an image was before mine eyes, there was silence, and I heard a voice, saying,
verses.pt: Parou ele, mas não pude discernir a sua aparencia; um vulto estava diante dos meus olhos; houve silêncio, então ouvi uma voz que dizia:
verses.en_web: It stood still, but I couldn’t discern its appearance. A form was before my eyes. Silence, then I heard a voice, saying,
verses.en_bbe: Something was present before me, but I was not able to see it clearly; there was a form before my eyes: a quiet voice came to my ears, saying:

verses.en: Shall mortal man be more just than God? shall a man be more pure than his maker?
verses.pt: Pode o homem mortal ser justo diante de Deus? Pode o varão ser puro diante do seu Criador?
verses.en_web: ‘Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?
verses.en_bbe: May a man be upright before God? or a man be clean before his Maker?

verses.en: Behold, he put no trust in his servants; and his angels he charged with folly:
verses.pt: Eis que Deus não confia nos seus servos, e até a seus anjos atribui loucura;
verses.en_web: Behold, he puts no trust in his servants. He charges his angels with error.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, he puts no faith in his servants, and he sees error in his angels;

verses.en: How much less in them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, which are crushed before the moth?
verses.pt: quanto mais aos que habitam em casas de lodo, cujo fundamento está no pó, e que são esmagados pela traça!
verses.en_web: How much more, those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!
verses.en_bbe: How much more those living in houses of earth, whose bases are in the dust! They are crushed more quickly than an insect;

verses.en: They are destroyed from morning to evening: they perish for ever without any regarding it.
verses.pt: Entre a manhã e a tarde são destruidos; perecem para sempre sem que disso se faça caso.
verses.en_web: Between morning and evening they are destroyed. They perish forever without any regarding it.
verses.en_bbe: Between morning and evening they are completely broken; they come to an end for ever, and no one takes note.

verses.en: Doth not their excellency which is in them go away? they die, even without wisdom.
verses.pt: Se dentro deles é arrancada a corda da sua tenda, porventura não morrem, e isso sem atingir a sabedoria?
verses.en_web: Isn’t their tent cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.’
verses.en_bbe: If their tent-cord is pulled up, do they not come to an end, and without wisdom?
